Summary (follows filters)

Website prices & cross-check

Three price layers, never mixed up: (1) operator's own station/network page (white dashed ring), (2) price the host reported to the DOE station database (ev_pricing free text; only unambiguous per-kWh values parsed; blue ring), (3) secondary sources – flagged inferred (orange dotted ring). Nothing is estimated; operators with conflicting or no figures stay grey. USD, before sales tax, checked 16 Oct 2026.

Station-level prices from operators' own pages: Mercedes-Benz HPC (14 Texas pages priced) and IONNA (26 Texas Rechargery pages). DOE-reported prices: 649 sites (490 free).

Cross-check

  • Tesla Supercharger: Only two tesla.com site pages could be read (via search index): San Antonio N Loop 1604 all-EV $0.48 day / $0.25 night; Dallas The Hill Tesla-owner $0.34 day / $0.14 night. ChargeCompass quotes the same $0.48 / $0.32 as a Texas 'approximate average'. tesla.com blocks automation → unverified, inferred.
  • Electrify America: EV Calc Lab and ChargeMap24 agree on $0.48 guest / $0.36 Pass+; EA's own page gives no figure and notes time-of-use sites (one report: $0.44–0.64). Inferred.
  • IONNA: Official network statement (never more than $0.39 + tax) agrees with every Texas Rechargery page read ($0.34 night / $0.39 day).
  • Mercedes-Benz HPC: Prices read from each station page; Temple/Baytown $0.49, Ennis $0.44 (page) vs PlugShare, Fort Worth page shows $0.00 (not used). Third-party trackers matched the pages for Baytown ($0.49, Jul 2026).
  • EVgo: Sources conflict ($0.42 older listing vs $0.39–0.60 time-of-use) → not coloured.
  • Austin Energy: Official $0.12203/kWh L2 (page reviewed 9 Oct 2026); AFDC lists one site at '$4.17 per month through Plug-In EVerywhere' (subscription, not parsed).

Data gaps

No price anywhere (≥10 sites, 0 priced): ChargePoint (1753), EVgo (91), Graviti Energy (68), EV Connect (64), Shell Recharge (34), Ford Charge (32), Noodoe (30), ChargeLab (11), Red E (11), Hyperfuel (10). ChargePoint prices are host-set per site; Shell Recharge, Blink, bp pulse, EVgo and Tesla Destination publish no usable Texas tariff.

Unknown power: 226 of 3,789 sites (6%) have no kW in AFDC – hidden by the power slider unless 'include unknown power' is ticked. Unknown AC/DC: 0 sites. Tesla-only sites: 251 (Tesla vehicles only; all-EV price not applied).

Excluded: private access: 240, status temporarily unavailable: 84, status planned: 23 (of 4,136 AFDC electric records for Texas). Temporarily unavailable sites are hidden until AFDC marks them available.

No supplement used: AFDC is the station source; Open Charge Map needs an API key and OSM Overpass was not merged, so sites missing from AFDC (new or unregistered chargers) are not shown. Texas utility programmes other than Austin Energy (CPS Energy, Oncor, etc.) have no public per-kWh tariff in AFDC beyond the 'Free' flags shown.
